page.layout: One column of running text. Running head with page number at the top right. No marginal notes, no notes below the text. Catchword "stratus" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: nam commutant. Hoc modo prisci Imperatores Ecclesiam gubernarunt. cont. Grot. p. 121. Cl. Rivetus in Decal. p. 262. dicit, etsi Magistratus non sit praedicare verbum, administrare sacramenta, Ecclesiasticam disciplinam exercere, tamen debere eum curare, ut isthaec fiant, sicut oportet ab iis, quos ad eadem Deus vocavit. Omnium apertissime Beza magnum illud lumen Ecclesiae, & summus assertor consistoriorum contra Thomam Erastum Professorem Heidelbergensem scribit: Cùm etiam à recte constituto consistorio possit reis delatis injuria fieri; in angustioribus territoriis citra ullam ordinis Ecclesiastici violationem Christianus Magistratus, ut tabulae utriusque & Ecclesiasticae εὐλα-ξίας custos & vindex prospicere potest conquerentibus. Cll. Proff. Leydenses in eadem sunt sententia & approbant illam ingenuam confessionem Bezae. Nam disputat. 48. th. 16. dicunt de disciplinâ Ecclesiasticâ: Hanc spiri-tualem potestatem à Christiani Magi-

page.notes: The header mark before "VII." is a Q-like sign that I read as "Q." with some doubt. Greek word "εὐλα-ξίας" is copied as printed; the accents are as far as I can make them out. Print shows "potest" with a long s, rendered as plain s. The catchword "stratus" is set at the right below the last line, and the text ends with the printed hyphen "Magi-" as on the page.
